_notes: Dan 3:55-57 (Vulgate) correspond to 思高 vv.54-56; mapping confirmed by content. Dan 3:58 (Vg) = 思高 v.57 (first form). In the second Benedicite form (3:57-88), Vulgate pairs two creatures per verse with *; 思高 gives them as separate verses — I have split the 思高 content at * accordingly. Vulgate 3:59 'aquæ super cælos' + 'omnes virtutes' = 思高 59+60; Vulgate 3:60 'sol et luna' + 'stellæ' = 思高 62+63 (思高 61 = military host, which maps to Vg virtutes). Verse 3:75 'Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu' is a liturgical doxology insertion not in the 思高 numbered canticle text; translated liturgically. 'Canticum Zachariæ' = 匝加利亚赞主曲 (Benedictus, Luke 1:68-79). Luke 1:68 has + (flex) after 'Benedíctus' — placed after 应受赞美 matching the Latin position. 思高 Luke 1:70 reads '正如他藉历代诸圣先知的口所说过的' (continuous); split at * between 'the mouth of the prophets' and 'who have been'; minor structural adjustment noted.
